tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Look up whether a business or organization already has a suggestion box on SuggestionBox.tips. Use before leaving a message when unsure which one the user means.

tools.name: leave_message
tools.description: Drop the user's feedback (a suggestion, a problem or a compliment) into the private suggestion box of any business or organization on SuggestionBox.tips. Private between the user and them. Confirm the wording with the user before sending. Give the website when you know it; otherwise its name and city.

city.description: City, needed when there is no website.

text.description: The message, in the user's words.

email.description: Optional. The user's email, only if they want to hear back.

ref.description: Optional order or booking number the message is about.
